faqs: What is a LinktreeIsDead and why do I need one?
One link to share everything you do and make. Put it in your Instagram, TikTok or YouTube bio, in an email signature, or on a printed QR code, and send people to every place they can find you.
Yes. Pick a theme or build your own with wallpapers, fonts, colours, button styles and shadows, and see every change in a live preview.
Can I make money with a LinktreeIsDead?
Not directly. There is no checkout or payments. You can link out to your own shop, course or tip jar like any other link.
What tools are included with LinktreeIsDead to grow and engage my audience?
Insights on views, clicks, traffic sources and devices, a subscribe button and forms that collect contacts, visitor messages, and link scheduling. All of it is free.
Is LinktreeIsDead safe to use on all social media platforms?
Your page is a normal, lightweight web page, so you can share the link anywhere a link is allowed. Visitors never need an account to see it.
No. There are no payments, fees or plans. The project is free and open source.
Do I need a website to use LinktreeIsDead?
No. Your page lives at one short link, so it can stand in for a website or sit alongside one.
Can I have multiple LinktreeIsDead pages, or use it as a team?
Each account has one page today. Team seats and multiple pages are not built yet; contributions are welcome on GitHub.
Where can I download the LinktreeIsDead app?
There is no app store app. Open the site in your phone's browser and add it to your home screen.
